name: Dranik’s Scar: Command
summary: The Muramite command center overseeing all operations across Dranik’s Scar.
description: Scar Command is the strategic heart of Muramite operations in Dranik’s Scar. Fortified command bunkers, Discord‑linked planning chambers, and war councils coordinate assaults across the Frontlines, Riftfields, and War‑Camps. Generals, warcasters, and logistics officers move through heavily guarded corridors, while resistance infiltrators attempt high‑risk sabotage against communication relays and command nodes. The area is saturated with arcane interference and military discipline, making it one of the most dangerous zones in Kuua.
